# Embedded Emissions for Pig Iron (CN 7201), India

The embedded emissions are **1,266.27 tCO2e**.

## Inputs

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7201 (Pig iron and spiegeleisen) | In table ✔ |
| (b) Country of production | India | Listed for CN 7201 ✔ |
| (c) Quantity | 500.5 tonnes | Provided ✔ |

All required inputs are present, so the figure can be computed.

## Factor

From the table, (CN 7201, India) gives a **default SEE of 2.53 tCO2e/t**.

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × Quantity
= 2.53 tCO2e/t × 500.5 t
= 1,266.265 tCO2e

Rounded to 2 decimal places (half-up): **1,266.27 tCO2e**

The unrounded value ends exactly on a 5. Round-half-up gives 1,266.27. Round-half-to-even would give 1,266.26. The ruleset does not specify a rounding convention, so I used standard half-up rounding.
